composite_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: S04 storage cupboard DAY CLOSED state, matching the existing DAY OPEN full composite.
Input Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY the two hinged upper cupboard doors from their open outward positions to fully shut across the shelf opening. The two plain walnut door leaves meet at one vertical center seam and conceal the four empty shelf tiers. Give the pair two very small simple round wooden knobs beside the central seam; no lock plates or labels. Their external framing and wood planks must match the existing door leaves. Preserve the cabinet body, crown board, width, height, feet, lower two drawers and their knobs exactly; the closed upper doors stop above those bottom drawers. Remove the old open leaves from their former open positions so the cream plaster wall is revealed behind them. This change is restricted to the upper door-opening/wing region, not a redesign of the cabinet.
Keep the camera, scale, crop, pendant lamp, surrounding wall, floor, far-right stockroom doorway, light and every unrelated object unchanged, and keep the same native image dimensions. No new objects or stock items.
Retain visible matte gouache brush strokes, dry-brush edges, slightly wobbly colored-pencil outlines, seven muted color families, soft diffuse daytime light and cool shadows. Full-bleed landscape.
NEGATIVE: text, letters, numbers, labels, blank plaques, UI, borders, gold filigree, ornate carving, glow, bloom, beams, bokeh, glossy plastic, photorealism, vines, plants, jars, books, stock.
